title: Elderly Rural Couple Alta & Erwin, 1950s Snapshot B&W Photo
description: A mid-1950s black-and-white square snapshot depicting an elderly couple, identified on the front margin as Alta and Erwin, standing in a grassy yard under a large tree. The man wears denim overalls and a cap, while the woman wears a floral dress. A dog lies on the ground beside them with white farm buildings in the background.
